claim: The changed COUNT/ADD answer and operand pearl sizing is materially more readable in the six reviewed run03 states, preserves grouping, and shows no clipping. This is a bounded review of pearl sizing only.

source_binding.binding_note: Answer groups derive radius from amount and card.size.x - 24 with max 40. Operand groups derive radius from amount and 241 available pixels with max 40. _draw_group retains five columns per row, exact token colors, centers, outlines and highlights.

comparison.capture_origin_limits: Intro frames use configured_phase_shortcut; partial and completion frames use live_gui_input. These are desktop Mobile-renderer captures, not target-device or child evidence.
comparison.content_equivalence_limit: The paired files are state- and lesson-content-equivalent but not pixel-identical because the pearl rendering changed. Read-only connected-component measurement of cyan interiors confirms one/two COUNT answer groups in all six COUNT files. ADD displays the same one-plus-one operands and two-/three-pearl answers in both runs.

count_measurement.method: Count four-connected cyan interior components larger than 100 pixels within answer-card rectangles x=474..681 and x=828..1036, y=455..623; no pixels were modified.

pairs.observation: The one- and two-pearl answers increase from visually tiny marks to clear objects. Both groups remain centered with ample card clearance.
The enlarged one- and two-pearl answer groups remain unclipped and distinct after the counted pearl changes to its check state.
The selected-card fill and star payoff do not obscure or clip the larger one-pearl answer; the two-pearl distractor remains clearly grouped.
Both single-pearl operand trays and the two-/three-pearl answer groups are substantially easier to see. Tray and card outlines retain generous clearance.
The joined two-pearl work group and both answer groups are clearly separated and unclipped. The larger answer pearls improve comparison with the central counted group.
The selected two-pearl group stays readable inside the filled payoff card and the star burst does not cover its pearls. The three-pearl alternative remains unclipped.

bounded_score.scope: Score applies only to the changed procedural pearl sizing in the six reviewed COUNT/ADD run03 frames relative to run02. It is not an overall Teacher surface, source-art, animation, device, child, or full-game score.

answer_card.note: COUNT/ADD currently construct two or three choices; both use 210px cards. The six visual samples exercise amounts 1, 2 and 3. Amounts 4-10 are arithmetic bounds, not visually accepted states.

operand_tray.note: Addition plans use operand amounts 1-5 in one row. The reviewed tier-0 intro exercises 1+1; amounts 2-5 are arithmetic bounds, not visually accepted states.

open_limits: Board composition, prompt text, cards, backgrounds, character mounting, and overall scene art were unchanged and were not rescored.
Pointer/demo-ring behavior was not assessed beyond confirming that the visible ring does not make the enlarged pearls clip.
No animated transition cadence, frame-by-frame contact, tier-1/tier-2 runtime capture, target-device, child, or owner acceptance is established.
The three COUNT and three ADD captures cover tier-0 amounts 1-3; higher supported counts are protected only by source arithmetic and remain visually open.
A bounded PASS does not establish registry-wide, Teacher-career, master-audit, or full-game acceptance.
publication_note: Exact-byte archived captures. Parent corrected the initial visual counting error using read-only pixel components: COUNT choices are one and two in both runs. No randomized-content inference. Bounded sizing acceptance only.
